title: RootKeyProduction
description: A single root PUBLIC key entry for the BANZA open financial protocol, held OFFLINE by one independent custodian under the 2-of-3 custody model. Public material only: this schema carries the key id, the custodian, the ed25519 PUBLIC key (base64url), a public fingerprint, and the creation timestamp. NO private key, seed, mnemonic or passphrase field exists here — for example a field like 'private_key' or 'seed_phrase' carrying secret bytes is FORBIDDEN and would make the ceremony INVALID (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_INVALID_FORBIDDEN_PRIVATE_KEY_MATERIAL). Each custodian holds exactly one root private key on their own offline device; no device holds more than one. Status is computed by applying the rules stated in this contract. The rules are the definition; no implementation of them is.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

key_id.description: Unique id of this root public key (e.g. 'root-key-A').

custodian.description: Independent custodian who holds the matching private key OFFLINE. A holds only root_key_A, B only root_key_B, C only root_key_C.

public_key.description: Root PUBLIC key material only (base64url, ed25519). Private keys are NEVER included in this or any BANZA artifact.

fingerprint.description: Public fingerprint (hash) of the root public key, for tamper-evident reference.

created_at.description: When this key pair was generated offline during the ceremony.
